channel.title: Humber Et Cetera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Humber Et Cetera (humberetc.ca)

item.title: Two dead following Air Canada crash at New York's LaGuardia Airport
item.description: Two pilots have died and 41 others have been taken to hospital following a crash involving an Air Canada flight and a firetruck at New York’s LaGuardia Airport.

item.title: Formula 1 postpones April races due to Middle East conflict
item.description: Bahrain and Saudi Arabia races have been called off with no replacements, leaving fans in suspense until May.

item.title: Has Toronto's tipping culture reached a tipping point?
item.description: With inflation putting pressure on household budgets, Canadians are reassessing everyday expenses, including tipping, a long-standing practice now facing growing scrutiny.

item.title: Q&A: Journalist Žiga Bonča says key reforms and foreign policy are top issues for polarized Slovenian electorate
item.description: Humber Et Cetera conducted an interview over email with Žiga Bonča to learn more about the importance of Slovenia’s 2026 parliamentary elections.

item.title: Protesters critique Ford, OSAP Guy for student funding changes
item.description: Premier Doug Ford hinted that Humber marketing student Etay Beaton became a reason OSAP grants are being cut.

item.title: Slovenia’s Golob ahead in photo-finish parliamentary vote after Janša faces fiery allegations
item.description: Allegations of corruption and foreign interference shaped Slovenia’s parliamentary vote on Sunday, which sees liberal incumbent Robert Golob leading conservative Janez Janša by a slim margin.

item.title: Supreme Court begins hearings on Quebec's religious symbols ban
item.description: Canada's Supreme Court is in session this week to hear arguments on Quebec's controversial law prohibiting civic employees from wearing personal religious symbols.

item.title: TALES FROM HUMBER: What tree-planting taught me about community, belonging
item.description: The isolation of tree-planting was easy to imagine. It was the communal living that terrified me, but it was ultimately just what I needed.

item.title: BREAKING NEWS: Layoffs loom for Humber’s faculty, staff
item.description: An email from the president alerted faculty and staff that the voluntary package some people had taken wasn't enough to offset the polytechnic's financial challenges, and layoffs are on the way.

item.title: Toronto's hidden gem for live music
item.description: A west-end Toronto cafe offers unique jazz-hip hop fusion music.
